sources.title: Open-Meteo Marine wave and sea-level forecast

license.name: Open-Meteo free-service terms (CC BY 4.0 noncommercial)

limitations: Coarse coastal resolution (~5-8 km); nearshore surge still requires local bathymetry and tidal gauge validation.

sources.title: Open-Meteo GloFAS global river discharge forecast

sources.coverage: Global 5 km river network.
limitations: 5 km river routing cannot resolve small urban drains or unmapped local diversions without calibration.
